RACE_RULES: Seven heats. Nine teams start each heat. Don't come in last: the last team across doesn't leave the track.
Try not to kill more than one team per heat. If more than two teams fail to finish, the System's threat was cut off mid-sentence; assume it's bad.
Teams are no bigger than four. Every heat needs a different driver, so a party of two alternates and a party of four has spares. Hired drivers count.
Party leader picks mechanical or biological; the wheel picks the chassis or creature. Pet spells don't work on special mounts.
The vehicle is fully repaired or healed between heats as long as a garage attendant is alive.
You may attack rival vehicles. You cannot steal them. No movement spells onto vehicles, yours or theirs.
Better finishes get more upgrade picks (1st: three picks at Gold; 2nd–4th: two picks up to Silver; 5th–7th: one pick at Bronze; 8th: audience vote). Everyone gets one Golden pick after heat 4.
You always get a hint of the next environment. The hint is honest, usually.
Mercenaries can be hired from the garage board between heats. The level timer is suspended for the floor.
